A #1 New York Times bestselling author, she has written many inspirational books, including The Mind Connection, Power Thoughts, the entire Battlefield of the Mind family of books, as well as many others. She has also released thousands of audio teachings, as well as a complete video library. Joyce's Enjoying Everyday Life radio and television programs are broadcast around the world, and she travels extensively conducting conferences.
